settings.heading: Refund Policy
settings.refund_policy_copy:
Due to the unique and pre-owned nature of our inventory, all sales are generally final.

Returns and exchanges

We do not accept returns or exchanges for:

  • Buyer’s remorse
  • Incorrect sizing
  • Change of mind

Problems with an order

However, if you receive:

  • The wrong item
  • An item that was materially different from its description
  • An item damaged during transit

Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery at contact@shopsoleparadisechicago.com so we can review the issue and work toward a resolution.

Authenticity

All merchandise sold by Sole Paradise is backed by our commitment to authenticity. If you have concerns regarding authenticity, please contact us immediately.
